tasks.name: redis
command: for LR_VENV in "${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}" /opt/literegistry-services-venv /opt/literegistry-terminal-venv /opt/literegistry-redis-venv; do if [[ -n "$LR_VENV" && -x "$LR_VENV/bin/python3" ]]; then export VIRTUAL_ENV="$LR_VENV" PATH="$LR_VENV/bin:$PATH"; break; fi; done; unset LR_VENV; set -euo pipefail; LR_GLOBAL_RANK=$((0 + ${BEAKER_REPLICA_RANK:-0})); LR_PREFERRED_PORT=$((55712 + LR_GLOBAL_RANK)); export LR_GLOBAL_RANK LR_PREFERRED_PORT; exec python3 -m literegistry.coop.ports run  --assignment "PORT=${LR_PREFERRED_PORT}" --identity "{IDENTITY}:redis:${LR_GLOBAL_RANK}" --host-id "${BEAKER_NODE_HOSTNAME:-unknown-node}" --command-json='["bash","-lc","for LR_VENV in \"${VIRTUAL_ENV:-}\" /opt/literegistry-services-venv /opt/literegistry-terminal-venv /opt/literegistry-redis-venv; do if [[ -n \"$LR_VENV\" && -x \"$LR_VENV/bin/python3\" ]]; then export VIRTUAL_ENV=\"$LR_VENV\" PATH=\"$LR_VENV/bin:$PATH\"; break; fi; done; unset LR_VENV; REDIS_ADVERTISE_HOST=\"${BEAKER_NODE_HOSTNAME:-$(hostname -f)}\"; export REDIS_ADVERTISE_HOST; exec literegistry redis --runtime=local --foreground=True --port=\"$PORT\" --advertise_host=\"$REDIS_ADVERTISE_HOST\" --head_registry=file://{RUN_DIR}/runtime/endpoint-files --data_dir={RUN_DIR}/runtime/services/.literegistry-coop/{IDENTITY}/redis-data --persistence=True"]' --lock_dir=/tmp/literegistry-port-locks --startup_timeout=120
